parameters.token: Random hex-based NIGHTFALL{...} token embedded in encrypted nested container
parameters.credential_salts: Randomized salt strings in credential hash entries
parameters.credential_hashes: Randomized hash suffixes in credential entries
parameters.master_key: Random 32-char hex master key in nested keystore
parameters.serial_number: Random serial identifier in nested keystore
parameters.key_material_seed: Random seed used to generate 150-byte XOR key schedule
